sidecar.export_tool: Autodesk Fusion, Save As Mesh (STL binary, mm); ATF 15.15.0.0 exporter header
sidecar.capture: 3D scan of the stock AtomRC Dolphin V1.1 airframe (scanner make/model and resolution not recorded)
excludes: propeller blades (only small debris shells present)
sidecar.measured_length_note: nose tip to aft-most point of the airframe shell in the Fusion Measure tool (scratch/dolphin/dolphin-measurements.jpg)
sidecar.notes: Fusion Y-up frame: source X = span, source Y = up, source Z = longitudinal with the nose at +Z.

evidence_class: measured design input (reference model); not validation truth; cannot supply mass, CG, or control neutrals

wing.twist_basis: chord-line incidence (mid-line extrapolated to the nose, trailing-edge point) fitted linearly over the straight band and evaluated at the body edge and the tip; relative to the root-chord datum; controls rotated back to neutral when a consistent significant deflection was found

deflection_fit.basis: deflection versus span fraction, robust linear

elevon.note: as-scanned control position (trailing edge up positive); transmitter trims unknown

deflection_fit.basis: deflection versus span fraction, robust linear

control_surface.note: as-scanned control position (trailing edge up positive); transmitter trims unknown

fins.root_junction_method: span line followed down to the fin-free body surface
span line followed down to the fin-free body surface

edge_method.right: body-core-reconstruction (envelope fill, width clamped to profile, bottom from profile (missing panel))
edge_method.left: body-core-reconstruction (envelope fill, width clamped to profile, bottom from profile (missing panel))

control_surface.note: Hinge line and span/chord fractions are measured; travel limits (max_up_deg/max_down_deg) are not measurable from a static scan. The as-scanned deflection is the control position at scan time (trailing edge up positive), not a trimmed-flight neutral.

notes: Wing edges depart from straight lines outboard of |y| = 0.397 m (rounded or raked tips); wing.sections preserves the measured outline while the scalar taper/sweep remain equivalent descriptors.

wing.sections t_over_c values are inferred loft controls: the measured mean t/c is scaled where the root/deck outline adds chord so absolute wing thickness is not inflated. Only the six airfoil cuts are direct section-thickness measurements.

The wing leading-edge nose was not captured at 33% of stations (both skins end at the same station); chord and x_le carry a 2%-chord allowance and the chord line uses the mid-line extrapolated to the nose.

Elevons were scanned deflected (+3.0 deg, trailing edge up positive). Twist and airfoil camber were measured on the undeflected chord line; do not read the deflection as a trimmed neutral without the measurement form section 2.

wing_planform.area_convention: gross projected area of the measured multi-section outline, including root blends/deck extensions represented by the station curve
wing_planform.section_t_over_c_basis: inferred from the measured mean wing t/c by preserving the straight-band absolute thickness where root/deck chord is larger; not a direct section-thickness measurement
